reason: A DSH Web UI plugin that accepts dragged local files or folders, resolves their native absolute paths, and inserts those paths into the conversation input without uploading or modifying the files.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 中拖入本地文件或文件夹，解析其原始绝对路径并插入当前对话输入框。
summaries.en: Drag local files or folders into the DSH Web UI to resolve and insert their original absolute paths into the current conversation input.

capabilities: Handles file and folder drag-and-drop in the DSH Web UI
Resolves local absolute filesystem paths using workspace searches, OS indexes, and bounded directory searches
Reads file metadata and may read sampled or full content to distinguish duplicate candidates
Writes resolved paths into the current conversation input
